PLAN "Body Composition and Insulin Sensitivity - 12 Weeks from 2026-06-01"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary body_composition:
    name "Reduce body fat and improve insulin sensitivity through progressive resistance training"
  GOAL secondary recovery:
    name "Maintain energy availability and recovery; avoid overtraining and under-fuelling"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 - Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Lower A":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          leg_press 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x30 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2m
          hip_flexor_stretch 2m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Upper A":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_press 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
          lat_stretch 2m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Full Body A":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          trap_bar_deadlift 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
